metadata.breaking_event: Breaking event scanner 2026-08-31 16:15 UTC: CAT-5s still active (US-Iran exchange + Hormuz supertanker mined; Treasury intervention failing). NEW: gold -3% to $4,452 (Warsh hawkish + strikes), Dow -400/S&P -0.47%, US debt $40T, China 300B yuan housing bailout, Fed discount-rate hike bids 4/12.

fin_stability.name: Financial Stability
fin_stability.note: Aug 31: gold -3% one-day drop (liquidation risk); front-end Treasury selloff, dollar surge post-Warsh. Fed minutes: 4/12 Reserve Bank boards voted discount-rate HIKE pre-FOMC (Reuters Aug 25) - stress precursor watch. Treasury buyback still failing to hold long end (2-decade highs).

sov_debt.name: Sovereign Debt Stress
sov_debt.note: Aug 31: US national debt crosses $40 TRILLION milestone (CNN). August yields at multi-year highs; expanded buybacks failed to stem rout. Debt-service pressure compounding via hike repricing.

energy.name: Energy Security
energy.note: Aug 31: crude $85.57 +2.6% on day (+32% YoY) as US-Iran traded strikes (first direct exchange in weeks, Aug 30). EIA assumes Hormuz flows 'severely constrained through August' - revised shut-in production up, inventories falling. Supertanker mined Aug 31 still halting traffic.

geopolitical.name: Geopolitical Conflict
geopolitical.description: VIX as market fear proxy (GDELT integration planned)
geopolitical.note: Aug 31: UK intel - Russia planning new offensive in Ukraine. Aug 29 Niger coup attempt (Tiani vs mutinous soldiers). Senegal cut to Caa2 Aug 28. DE-ESCALATION: Trump pauses 50% Canada tariffs, cites 'deal'.

currency.name: Currency Stability
currency.note: Aug 31 confirmed: USD/JPY 160.16-160.20 - all joint-intervention gains erased despite $97B (JPY 15.4T) spent Jul 30-Aug 26. JGB 10Y 2.95% highest since Sept 1996; 2Y 31-yr high; 5Y record after weak auction. Traders on intervention watch; second MOF intervention likely.

gold.name: Gold / Precious Metals
gold.value: ESCALATED: gold plunged 3%+ to $4,452/oz Aug 31 after Warsh hawkish Jackson Hole (hotter US inflation, >70% odds Fed HIKE by Dec) + renewed US-Iran strikes. Dollar surged, front-end Treasuries sold off. Largest one-day drop of the war period; debasement trade unwinding. Down $280 (-6%) from Aug 24 print $4,732. Watch forced-liquidation cascade risk.

china.name: China Health
china.description: OECD Composite Leading Indicator for China (PMI proxy)
china.note: Aug 30-31: State launches 300B yuan housing bailout to avert 'sudden, catastrophic financial collapse' - aims to keep banks/devs from failing but won't revive market (analysts). PBOC still capping yuan appreciation (3.5-yr high). Chronic property degradation continues.

europe.name: Europe Stability
europe.description: ECB Deposit Rate (proxy for EU stability)
europe.note: Aug 31: global bond yields surging (CNN); gilt >5% chronic. ECB hiked 25bp in response to Middle East war inflation shock (headline 2026 proj 3.0%); Schnabel: further tightening necessary. Oil/energy shock rotation to gas - growth outlook at risk.

us_cycle.name: US Cycle Position
us_cycle.note: Aug 31: Dow -400 (-1%+), S&P -0.47%, Nasdaq -0.41% on oil surge + Fed hike repricing (>70% by Dec). Hotter-than-expected inflation reading. Bessent-Warsh collision over buybacks continues. Curve 10Y-2Y +0.39.

middle_east.name: Middle East Tension
middle_east.description: Brent Oil as ME tension proxy
middle_east.note: Aug 30-31 direct US-Iran kinetic exchange continues: Larak Island strikes, supertanker mined, Iran missiles at 2 US bases in Jordan, Kharg claims. Iran dismisses new sanctions. Oman-Iran talks on Hormuz 'toll'. Qatari PM to Tehran for de-escalation. Trump claims 'complete control'.
